summary: Deleted both parts from RD-1015: each Delete opened an in-page "Confirm" modal ("Delete part"), which I accepted; after the second the Parts table showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with the total at $0.00, and the status did NOT change when the parts were removed — it stayed "Ready" (which is itself odd given the earlier Ready precondition required suppliers). I then clicked "Archive ticket": no confirm dialog and no precondition error — the button immediately flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and the page showed the status as "Status / Ready" plus an "Archived" badge. Verified not active: the tickets list went from "Showing 1–10 of 14" to "Showing 1–10 of 13", RD-1015 is absent from the active rows (RD-1014…RD-1004), and ticking "Show archived" surfaces the row "RD-1015 fwrd82-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived Bench Test Ltd Ready 0 2026-09-22" (0 parts).
